newsitem.title: PERU: Peru cenbank seeks lower assets/net worth ratio.
newsitem.headline: Peru cenbank seeks lower assets/net worth ratio.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank President German Suarez wants the country's commercial banks' maximum ratio of risk-weighted assets to net worth to be lowered, the government daily El Peruano reported Tuesday.

Suarez has called for the forthcoming Banks' Law to restrict a bank to having in its portfolio risk assets with a value only ten times the bank's net worth, down from a current limit of 12.5 times the net worth, El Peruano said.
The central bank seeks the change "so that the banking system can more easily face any external shock the economy might suffer," El Peruano said.
Congress is currently debating a banking bill proposed by the government.
